title: Shown speed vs recorded speed uses a 25 percent tolerance
notes: TestAWorkersShownSpeedIsTheOneItRecordedAndHoldsAcrossAPause compares shown speed with the recorded value using before < recorded*0.75 || before > recorded*1.25. This is a comparison of two measured speeds with a bound; it is not in timing-bounds.txt. It is probably stable on a paused job, but it is not exact and was not exercised under load.
